question_set.question: Use highlight_category with field equal to field,values, values equal to Heavy to compare the consistency of vitamin intake types A, C, and D with the trend of changes in symptoms_count in order to know what is the consistency of vitamin intake types with the trend of changes in symptoms_count?

answer.value: Thallium is the most effective dimension for distinguishing heart disease patients, with the highest separability score of 1.23 and a mean difference of 0.5117 between presence and absence groups. ST depression and Max HR also show good separation with separability scores of 0.92 each. In contrast, Cholesterol shows the weakest separation with only 0.24 separability, suggesting it is less useful as a standalone predictor for heart disease.

key_insights: Thallium shows highest separability (1.23) making it most effective dimension
ST depression and Max HR also show good separation (0.92)
Cholesterol shows weakest separation (0.24) suggesting limited predictive value
Parallel coordinates visualization reveals which dimensions are most useful for classification

reasoning_trace.rationale: Use highlight_category to highlight patients with heart disease presence, which allows visual comparison of their patterns across all six dimensions to identify which dimensions show the most distinct separation
